rationale: Detected PHP floor is 8.1 (heuristic scan), below the target 8.3 — require.php is widened to ">=8.1" for genuine Drupal 10 (PHP 8.1) support.
Adding Drupal 11 support without dropping a supported core major -> MINOR.
warnings: require.php was lowered to ">=8.1" from a best-effort syntactic scan. CONFIRM with PHPCompatibility (testVersion 8.1-) before release: a missed newer construct would let a Drupal 10 + PHP<8.3 site install and then fatal at runtime. Set DRUPILOT_REQUIRE_PHP_FLOOR=target to keep the conservative ">=8.3".

Drupal 10's own minimum is PHP 8.1, but this port's floor is 8.1. require.php ">=8.1" blocks D10 sites below that floor at install time (composer) rather than fataling at runtime. If you do not need the D10 transition window, drop to '^11'.

Drupal 10 compatibility is DECLARED, not verified. drupal-rector's standard replacements are usually available across all of Drupal 10 (deprecation contract), but this was not checked here. If the port uses an API added in a later 10.x minor, set core_version_requirement to e.g. '^10.3 || ^11'; if it uses an API absent from Drupal 10, drop to '^11'. The AI digests / ad-hoc Rector layer may introduce replacements newer than Drupal 10.0, so a raised minor (e.g. '^10.3 || ^11') is more likely — check it.

manual_items.what: 'Drupal\legacy_widgets\WidgetLookUp' does not match the real file 'src/WidgetLookup.php' (case differs): works on a case-insensitive filesystem, fatals on Linux.

LegacyWidget::getOriginal() collides with core's EntityInterface::getOriginal() added in Drupal 11.2 and is incompatible (return type 'none' (core: ?static or static)): a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' when the class loads on 11.2+.
SettingsForm::__construct() passes 1 argument(s) to ConfigFormBase::__construct(), which requires 2 from Drupal 11.0: ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
